limits: Timings may overlap. End-day samples measure synchronous processing/dispatch, while simulate-until includes async world-sync and event-loop yields. Database times include queue/commit latency. Do not sum nested rows.
Engine-search latency includes startup/queue and analyses, not just one move; budget is requested engine time, not a promise about elapsed time.
File fetch may be served by browser/PWA cache; memory source specifically means the in-process city cache.
FPS/lag/heap are browser observations. Profiling adds small overhead. Tested in managed Chromium/emulation, not physical Termux/Android/iOS, and Cloud numbers do not predict device performance.
